items.title: 15.1 Mixtures alag karne ke tareeqe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.1 (Methods of Separation of Mixtures), printed page 324.

blocks.text: Mixture ke ajza physical tareeqon se alag kiye ja sakte hain: filtration, crystallization, simple distillation, fractional distillation aur paper chromatography. Har ek agle topics mein bayan hai.

blocks.caption: Paanch tareeqe
rows: liquid ya solution se na-halne wala solid
halne wale solid ko us ki na-pakiyon se
mukhtalif boiling points ke do milne wale (miscible) liquids
chhote namoone mein halne wale madde

blocks.prompt: Har mixture ke liye kaun si technique munasib hai: petroleum aur pani; NaCl aur NaNO3; activated charcoal aur sodium chloride; methanol, ethanol aur propanol (Quick Check 15.5b)?
blocks.explanation: Petroleum aur pani na-milne wale liquids hain: separating funnel se alag karein, ya distil karein. NaCl aur NaNO3 do halne wale solids hain: un ki mukhtalif solubilities istemal karte hue pani se fractional crystallization. Charcoal aur sodium chloride: namak pani mein hal karein aur na-halne wala charcoal filter karein, phir crystallize karein. Methanol, ethanol aur propanol mukhtalif boiling points wale milne wale liquids hain: fractional distillation.

items: Physical alag karne ke tareeqe: filtration, crystallization, simple distillation, fractional distillation, paper chromatography.
